intro: Along Duskwood's road, Watcher Backus keeps watch for danger and suspicious traffic tied to Stormwind's political intrigues. He patrols between Darkshire and Manor Mistmantle, watching for undead and strange travelers.

p: Watcher Backus walks a solitary beat north of Darkshire, passing near Manor Mistmantle. Like the rest of the Night Watch, he struggles against Duskwood's curse. Stormwind's garrison gives the region little support, so local volunteers guard its misty paths on their own. Backus keeps beast and ghoul at bay along the road.
